about: Soccer Celebration In A Bar is a GIF of a packed pub full of England fans watching a match on a TV screen. For a few tense seconds they stare up at the screen, then the place erupts: drinks fly through the air, people leap on each other and the whole room loses its mind. The meme swaps what is on the TV for something trivial, so the crowd's explosive joy looks wildly out of proportion. That mismatch is the entire joke, the over-the-top celebration of a tiny win, whether it is a green build, a reply text or the microwave stopping at exactly zero.
origin: The footage was filmed in a bar in England during the Euro 2016 tournament, when the national team scored against Wales. Clips of the celebration spread online soon after and became a popular base for edits.
usage:
This template has two caption boxes timed to the GIF, both placed over the TV screen. The first box shows during the tense build-up while the fans are watching, so write the thing they are waiting on (“push to CI”). The second box appears as they explode, so write the small victory (“it turns green”).

The smaller and more mundane the win, the funnier the riot. Office life, programming, school results, sports betting slips and household chores all work well, as long as the second line is a genuine relief that people would recognize.
ideas: waiting to see if she texts back
